title: Look at the real data before writing the parser
content: Open the actual gazette pages, registry exports and client spreadsheets first; the edge cases live in the data, not in the spec.

title: Test in the real thing
content: A feature is done when it works against production-shaped data in the real browser, not when a mock agrees with me.

title: Make the failure mode expensive to reintroduce
content: Every bug that reaches production comes back as a regression test, a database constraint or a type, so the same mistake fails loudly next time.

title: Say plainly what broke
content: Status reports name what failed, why, and what changed; a clear bad-news report beats a vague good one.
